lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa apuno kar leenaa man vasiaa abinaasee ||2||
lines.translation: By His Mercy, He has made me His own, and the imperishable Lord has come to dwell within my mind. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਲਾਗੈ ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa kau bighan na kooo laagai jo satigur apunai raakhe ||
lines.translation: No misfortune afflicts one who is protected by the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਬਸੇ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal base rid a(n)tar a(n)mrit har ras chaakhe ||3||
lines.translation: The Lotus Feet of God come to abide within his heart, and he savors the sublime essence of the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੇਵਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar sevaa sevak prabh apune jin man kee ichh pujaaee ||
lines.translation: So, as a servant, serve your God, who fulfills your mind's desires.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੨੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak daas taa kai balihaarai jin pooran paij rakhaaee ||4||14||25||
lines.translation: Slave Nanak is a sacrifice to the Perfect Lord, who has protected and preserved his honor. ||4||14||25||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨੁ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੈ ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa moh magan a(n)dhiaarai devanahaar na jaanai ||
lines.translation: Infatuated with the darkness of emotional attachment to Maya, he does not know the Lord, the Great Giver.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿਆ ਬਲੁ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d saaj jin rachiaa bal apuno kar maanai ||1||
lines.translation: The Lord created his body and fashioned his soul, but he claims that his power is his own. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੂੜੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mooRe dekh rahio prabh suaamee ||
lines.translation: O foolish mind, God, your Lord and Master is watching over you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕਛੂਐ ਛਾਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karahi soee soee jaanai rahai na kachhooai chhaanee || rahaau ||
lines.translation: Whatever you do, He knows; nothing can remain concealed from Him. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸੁਆਦ ਲੋਭ ਮਦਿ ਮਾਤੋ ਉਪਜੇ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jihavaa suaad lobh mad maato upaje anik bikaaraa ||
lines.translation: You are intoxicated with the tastes of the tongue, with greed and pride; countless sins spring from these.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਰਮਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਕੇ ਭਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bahut jon bharamat dukh paaiaa haumai ba(n)dhan ke bhaaraa ||2||
lines.translation: You wandered in pain through countless incarnations, weighed down by the chains of egotism. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਇ ਕਿਵਾੜ ਅਨਿਕ ਪੜਦੇ ਮਹਿ ਪਰ ਦਾਰਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਫਾਕੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dei kivaaR anik paRade mahi par daaraa sa(n)g phaakai ||
lines.translation: Behind closed doors, hidden by many screens, the man takes his pleasure with another man's wife.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਜਬ ਲੇਖਾ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਤਬ ਕਉਣੁ ਪੜਦਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਢਾਕੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: chitr gupat jab lekhaa maagahi tab kaun paRadaa teraa dhaakai ||3||
lines.translation: When Chitr and Gupt, the celestial accountants of the conscious and subconscious, call for your account, who will screen you then? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਤੁਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਓਟ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: deen daiaal pooran dukh bha(n)jan tum bin ot na kaaee ||
lines.translation: O Perfect Lord, Merciful to the meek, Destroyer of pain, without You, I have no shelter at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਢਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੨੬॥
lines.transliteration: kaadh lehu sa(n)saar saagar mahi naanak prabh saranaaee ||4||15||26||
lines.translation: Please, lift me up out of the world-ocean; O God, I have come to Your Sanctuary. ||4||15||26||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਹਾਈ ਕਥਾ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: paarabraham hoaa sahaaee kathaa keeratan sukhadaaee ||
lines.translation: The Supreme Lord God has become my helper and friend; His sermon and the Kirtan of His Praises have brought me peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਜਪਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur poore kee baanee jap anad karahu nit praanee ||1||
lines.translation: Chant the Word of the Perfect Guru's Bani, and be ever in bliss, O mortal. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har saachaa simarahu bhaaee ||
lines.translation: Remember the True Lord in meditation, O Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਜਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)g sadaa sukh paaeeai har bisar na kabahoo jaaee || rahaau ||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, eternal peace is obtained, and the Lord is never forgotten. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਜੋ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਸੋ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit naam paramesar teraa jo simarai so jeevai ||
lines.translation: Your Name, O Transcendent Lord, is Ambrosial Nectar; whoever meditates on it, lives.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਥੀਵੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jis no karam paraapat hovai so jan niramal theevai ||2||
lines.translation: One who is blessed with God's Grace - that humble servant becomes immaculate and pure. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਘਨ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਸਨ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bighan binaasan sabh dukh naasan gur charanee man laagaa ||
lines.translation: Obstacles are removed, and all pains are eliminated; my mind is attached to the Guru's feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਅਚੁਤ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਜਾਗਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: gun gaavat achut abinaasee anadin har ra(n)g jaagaa ||3||
lines.translation: Singing the Glorious Praises of the immovable and imperishable Lord, one remains awake to the Lord's Love, day and night. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਸੇਈ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: man ichhe seee phal paae har kee kathaa suhelee ||
lines.translation: He obtains the fruits of his mind's desires, listening to the comforting sermon of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਮਧਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਆ ਬੇਲੀ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੨੭॥
lines.transliteration: aad a(n)t madh naanak kau so prabh hoaa belee ||4||16||27||
lines.translation: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, God is Nanak's best friend. ||4||16||27||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਪੰਚਪਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 pa(n)chapadaa ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, Panch-Padhay:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਅਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਅਪਨੀ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: binasai mohu meraa ar teraa binasai apanee dhaaree ||1||
lines.translation: May my emotional attachment, my sense of mine and yours, and my self-conceit be dispelled. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਇਹਾ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ਕਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tahu ihaa bataavahu kaaree ||
lines.translation: O Saints, show me such a way,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit haumai garab nivaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: by which my egotism and pride might be eliminated. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਭੂਤ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਹੋਵਾਂ ਸਗਲ ਰੇਨਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sarab bhoot paarabraham kar maaniaa hovaa(n) sagal renaaree ||2||
lines.translation: I see the Supreme Lord God in all beings, and I am the dust of all. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਸੰਗੇ ਚੂਕੈ ਭੀਤਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: pekhio prabh jeeu apunai sa(n)ge chookai bheet bhramaaree ||3||
lines.translation: I see God always with me, and the wall of doubt has been shattered. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਉਖਧੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਲੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੀ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: aukhadh naam niramal jal a(n)mrit paaeeai guroo duaaree ||4||
lines.translation: The medicine of the Naam, and the Immaculate Water of Ambrosial Nectar, are obtained through the Guru's Gate. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਰੋਗ ਬਿਦਾਰੀ ॥੫॥੧੭॥੨੮॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak jis masatak likhiaa tis gur mil rog bidaaree ||5||17||28||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, one who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead, meets with the Guru, and his diseases are cured. ||5||17||28||
